project.title: Central Canadian Wastewater Surveillance Pilot Study
project.description: This project investigates AMR in wastewater across urban, rural, and remote communities in central Canada using longitudinal probe-capture metagenomic sequencing with the CARD v1.0.0 panel. Weekly influent samples were collected over nine weeks from six wastewater treatment plants (49 samples). Each sample underwent probe-capture metagenomics, as well as qPCR for a panel of microbial indicators and ARGs.
